name: google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geomancer/AGENT.python.tools.md

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.render_mesh_image: render a 3D mesh image using MuJoCo physics with a given quaternion rotation and light direction
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.compute_tangent_vectors: compute image tangent vectors by finite differences for quaternion rotation and light direction perturbations
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.get_normal_vectors: get vectors normal to a unit vector using singular value decomposition
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.run_data_writer: run the data writer CLI to render images and save shards with latents and tangents to NPZ files
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.review_render_function: review the render function that builds a MuJoCo MJCF scene and renders a 3D mesh

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.run_GEOMANCER_fit: run the GEOMANCER fit function to estimate manifold components from a dataset of points
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.build_knn_graph: build a k-nearest neighbors graph from numpy data using make_nearest_neighbors_graph
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.compute_tangent_vectors: compute tangent vectors for each data point using make_tangents with a neighbor graph
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.run_ffdiag_diagonalization: run the orthogonal FFDiag algorithm to simultaneously diagonalize a set of matrices
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.cluster_eigenvector_subspaces: cluster subspace dimensions from Laplacian eigenvectors using cluster_subspaces and ffdiag

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.test_sym_op: test the sym_op function to verify QXQ' transformation on symmetric matrices with optional zero trace
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.test_vec_to_sym: test the vec_to_sym function to convert a vector back into a symmetric matrix representation
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.test_ffdiag: test the ffdiag function to find a common diagonalizing matrix for a set of matrices
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.test_make_nearest_neighbors_graph: test the make_nearest_neighbors_graph function to build a k-nearest-neighbor graph from 2D data points
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.test_geomancer_test_suite: run the full geomancer test suite covering sym_op, ffdiag, and nearest neighbor graph construction

google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.run_geomancer_on_synthetic_manifolds: run GEOMANCER on a product of synthetic manifolds like S^2 x S^2 using the CLI
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.generate_product_manifold_data: generate synthetic data points from a product of SO(n) and sphere manifolds with make_product_manifold
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.compute_so_tangent_basis: compute an orthonormal tangent space basis for a given SO(n) orthonormal matrix using make_so_tangent
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.compute_sphere_tangent_basis: compute the tangent space basis for a point on a sphere using make_sphere_tangent
google-deepmind_deepmind-research/geoman.compute_true_tangents_for_manifold: compute orthonormal tangent bases for each submanifold in a product manifold using make_true_tangents
